allowlist.name: CrateReceiptV1
allowlist.failure_mode: Legacy same-name receipt shapes could be reinterpreted across schema/identity domains
allowlist.why_temporarily_allowed: Both V1 definitions already exist; equivalence is not assumed and no adapter may promote one into the other
allowlist.removal_condition: Resolve named consumer overlap with versioned owner contract or rename the nonowner surface

allowlist.name: ExecutionStopReason
allowlist.failure_mode: An execution stop may be mistaken for a control disposition
allowlist.why_temporarily_allowed: Existing owner-local stop contracts are not implicitly interchangeable
allowlist.removal_condition: Add typed mapping/conformance or domain-qualified V2 naming before removing allowance

allowlist.name: Outcome
allowlist.failure_mode: Same-name outcomes may launder success predicates between receipt families
allowlist.why_temporarily_allowed: Existing V1 names are quarantined at exact paths without assuming shared semantics
allowlist.removal_condition: Resolve actual consumer overlap and retire or version the duplicate domain contract

allowlist.name: RefutationResult
allowlist.failure_mode: Decoder status could be promoted into causal-verification evidence
allowlist.why_temporarily_allowed: Existing decoder and causal evidence records serve different inspected paths
allowlist.removal_condition: Add negative cross-family conformance and domain-qualified V2 naming

allowlist.name: Syndrome
allowlist.failure_mode: Memory decoder output could be mistaken for kernel proof
allowlist.why_temporarily_allowed: Both owner-local V1 surfaces exist at fixed definitions
allowlist.removal_condition: Require explicit conversion and proof boundary or rename/version the local surface

allowlist.name: ContradictionStatus
allowlist.failure_mode: Candidate/resolved claim support states may be confused with bridge projection status
allowlist.why_temporarily_allowed: V1 variants differ; relationship remains mapping-required, not declared equivalent
allowlist.removal_condition: Prove a typed loss-aware mapping or separate versioned names and remove exception

allowlist.name: EvidenceBundle
allowlist.failure_mode: Claim-support evidence could be silently read as causal verification or vice versa
allowlist.why_temporarily_allowed: Source fields demonstrate distinct families; no implicit cross-family conversion is allowed
allowlist.removal_condition: Add cross-language/cross-family negative fixtures and domain-qualified public wire names

allowlist.name: LedgerEntry
allowlist.failure_mode: Verification case entry could be treated as claim-support admission
allowlist.why_temporarily_allowed: Existing claim and verification event families use distinct source types and digest/identity contracts
allowlist.removal_condition: Add explicit adapter or domain-qualified V2 names; then remove temporary allowance

allowlist.name: LedgerEvent
allowlist.failure_mode: Verification case event could be treated as claim-support event
allowlist.why_temporarily_allowed: Existing event variants differ; no same-name conversion is admitted
allowlist.removal_condition: Add explicit adapter or domain-qualified V2 names; then remove temporary allowance
